      "observations": [
        "All owned hunks in 25 paths were read, including all 13 copied-fixture diffs, the complete new seven-line SVG and the browser-test addition. Exact NUL paths/ancestry and product/directive preflight passed; no Suite source. This is human functional UI/test/resource work, not bulk.",
        "Production auto-form markup adds a type=button with localized text and decorative alt-empty image, a localized or divider, and autofocus on the real-name input. Middle-content is forwarded through step and header slots. CSS hides the header by default and changes it to flex under mail.accounthub.thundermail.enabled; this commit does not add the preference default. Reuse the separate preference/default/policy source lesson only in its checked scope.",
        "Delegated self click listener is installed under the existing hasConnected guard. The original click case matches composedTarget.closest(button) and fires #handleForwardAction(autoConfigSubview) with example@thundermail.com/placeholder, without awaiting it. Normal submit/forward instead awaits that method within a catch that clears abortable state and reports a notification.",
        "The actual auto-configuration action starts loading, disables current subview/footer, resets config/Exchange username, awaits #findConfig, handles redirect confirmation and fallback/config views, and explicitly rethrows some errors. The new unawaited click call therefore does not use the normal forward branch's awaited catch. This is a source-level completion/error boundary, not a reproduced login or rejection failure.",
        "Current accepted click route is a later dedicated OAuth2Module flow: state/disabled guards, configurable hostname, pending state, cancellation, token callback promise and decoded identity before auto-configuration delegation. That later flow must not be credited to this original UI/placeholder patch or taken as a live service/token claim.",
        "The new test directly checks the default subview header hidden, pushes the pref true, appends a new email-auto-form, then checks BrowserTestUtils.isVisible(newForm). Its message names the sign-in button, but its actual target is the entire form. Both messages are nonempty/should; the second expected-behavior description is broader than the checked control.",
        "The loaded historical accountHubEmailAutoForm.xhtml fixture clones its own templates. It retains hidden on the Thundermail header, lacks the new middle-content forwarding slots and still has older button/divider markup. Other 13 copied fixtures are updated by this patch, but this loaded fixture is not. The test does not demonstrate the production slot route; native projection/rendering was not run. Accepted later tests target/wait for the real header and assert new body/title placement.",
        "CSS uses logical size/margin properties, local primary/surface tokens, a 24x24 lg asset displayed at 20x20 and paired jar/icon-variable URLs. The divider text has translator context. The patch's two showBrandingHeader JSDocs describe already existing methods, not new method behavior. Actual focus order, computed contrast, max-font overflow and accessible names were not tested.",
        "Manual readability: keep preference mutation, form creation/attachment, actual control assertion and cleanup separate. The new test removes its appended form, adopting that review request. Existing hasConnected guards preserve listener identity; no unrelated cleanup or global slot/icon naming rule is inferred. A local suggestion is to await the delegated action under the established error handler rather than detach its completion, if preserving the intended async UI contract.",
        "Complete retained primary 2020821 describes a false preference and a placeholder identity to reach OAuth. Comment 1 explicitly separates adding the preference into another task. Comments 0–3, activity and footer were read; regression locators 2048607/2048609 were not opened. This landing does not prove successful live authentication.",
        "Complete retained D287500 includes all 25 actual submitted inline bodies, three literal code suggestions and three required older inline views, with no summary edits. The review requests SVG packaging, button type, translator context, DOM cleanup and qualified brand/icon choices; the owned source contains type=\"button\", the localized divider comment, newForm.remove(), the large icon resource and shared brand token. These are concrete source checks, not adoption inferred from Done or acceptance.",
        "The author says the existing OAuth flow handles all states. That claim does not establish the original click completion contract: its placeholder forward call is unawaited while the ordinary forward event awaits and catches errors. The historical handler can rethrow failures. Later accepted dedicated OAuth token/identity handling is a separate phase, and its final forward call also remains unawaited in the inspected window.",
        "Slot order, pseudo-elements and copied-fixture formatting have explicit proposals or rebuttals. Vertical overflow is deferred before default enablement; later full-name focus/validation feedback and Try reports remain historical discussion. The source adds autofocus but no native focus, accessibility, overflow or validation run was performed.",
        "The new positive preference test checks BrowserTestUtils.isVisible(newForm), although its message names the sign-in button. Its historical loaded fixture retains a hidden header and lacks the production forwarding slots. Later accepted tests check the actual header and layout, which does not give this original test direct control coverage. All changed assertion messages are non-empty and contain should."
